inputs.label: Target(s):
inputs.help: Target IP address(es), hostnames, ranges (e.g., 192.168.1.1, example.com, 192.168.1.1-10, 192.168.1.0/24). For multiple targets, separate with spaces or use a file.

inputs.label: Target List File (-iL):
inputs.help: File containing a list of targets (one per line).

inputs.label: Upload Target List:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing a list of targets (one per line).

inputs.label: Exclude Hosts (--exclude):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of hosts to exclude.

inputs.label: Exclude File (--excludefile):
inputs.help: File containing a list of hosts to exclude (one per line).

inputs.label: Random Hosts (-iR):
inputs.help: Scan N random hosts (e.g., '10').

inputs.label: Input from stdin (-iS)
inputs.help: Read targets from standard input.

inputs.label: No Ping (--Pn):
inputs.help: Treat all hosts as online -- skip host discovery.

inputs.label: Ping Scan (-sP):
inputs.help: Only perform host discovery (ping scan).

inputs.label: List Scan (-sL):
inputs.help: List targets to scan without running a scan.

inputs.label: Disable DNS Resolution (-n):
inputs.help: Never do DNS resolution.

inputs.label: Force DNS Resolution (-R):
inputs.help: Always resolve DNS for all target IPs.

inputs.label: System DNS Resolver (--system-dns):
inputs.help: Use system DNS resolver (slower).

inputs.label: DNS Servers (--dns-servers):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of DNS servers to use.

inputs.label: SYN Scan (-sS)
inputs.help: Stealth SYN scan (default and fastest). Requires root privileges.

inputs.label: Connect Scan (-sT)
inputs.help: TCP connect() scan. Slower than SYN, but works without root privileges.

inputs.label: UDP Scan (-sU)
inputs.help: UDP scan. Can be very slow.

inputs.label: ACK Scan (-sA)
inputs.help: ACK scan. Used to map firewall rulesets, not to determine open ports.

inputs.label: Window Scan (-sW)
inputs.help: Window scan. Similar to ACK scan, but can sometimes detect open ports.

inputs.label: Maimon Scan (-sM)
inputs.help: Maimon scan. Advanced scan type, similar to FIN/Xmas/Null.

inputs.label: FIN Scan (-sF)
inputs.help: FIN scan. Stealthy, sends FIN packets.

inputs.label: Xmas Scan (-sX)
inputs.help: Xmas scan. Stealthy, sets FIN, PSH, URG flags.

inputs.label: Null Scan (-sN)
inputs.help: Null scan. Stealthy, sends packets with no flags set.

inputs.label: IP Protocol Scan (-sO)
inputs.help: IP protocol scan. Discovers supported IP protocols (TCP, UDP, ICMP, etc.).

inputs.label: Fast Scan (-F)
inputs.help: Scan fewer ports than the default scan.

inputs.label: Fragment Packets (-f)
inputs.help: Fragment IP packets into tiny pieces. Can evade simple firewalls.

inputs.label: Don't Show Reason (--noreason)
inputs.help: Don't print the reason a host or port is in a particular state.

inputs.label: IPv6 Scan (-6)
inputs.help: Enable IPv6 scanning.

inputs.label: Append Output (--append-output)
inputs.help: Append to specified output files rather than clobbering them.

inputs.label: Disable Host Discovery (-Pn)
inputs.help: Treat all hosts as online -- skip host discovery.

inputs.label: Scan Only Specified Ports (-p)
inputs.help: Only scan ports specified with -p.

inputs.label: SYN/ACK Discovery (-PS/-PA):
inputs.help: TCP SYN/ACK discovery on specified ports (e.g., '22,80,443').

inputs.label: UDP Discovery (-PU):
inputs.help: UDP discovery on specified ports (e.g., '53,161').

inputs.label: SCTP INIT Scan (-sY)
inputs.help: SCTP INIT scan.

inputs.label: SCTP COOKIE-ECHO Scan (-sZ)
inputs.help: SCTP COOKIE-ECHO scan.

inputs.label: Idle Scan (-sI):
inputs.help: Idle scan (zombie host). e.g., 'zombie.example.com'.

inputs.label: Protocol Scan (-sO)
inputs.help: IP protocol scan.

inputs.label: Decoy Scan (-D):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of decoy IP addresses (e.g., 'ME,192.168.1.1,10.0.0.1').

inputs.label: Spoof MAC Address (--spoof-mac):
inputs.help: MAC address to spoof (e.g., '00:0C:29:12:34:56' or 'Dell').

inputs.label: Source Port (--source-port):
inputs.help: Specify source port number.

inputs.label: Data Length (--data-length):
inputs.help: Append random data to sent packets.

inputs.label: Bad Checksum (--badsum)
inputs.help: Send packets with a bogus TCP/UDP/SCTP checksum.

inputs.label: Ports (-p):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of ports or ranges (e.g., '21,22,80,1-1024').

inputs.label: Exclude Ports (--exclude-ports):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of ports or ranges to exclude.

inputs.label: Fast Scan (-F)
inputs.help: Scan fewer ports than the default scan (top 100).

inputs.label: All Ports (-p-)
inputs.help: Scan all 65535 ports.

inputs.label: Top Ports (--top-ports):
inputs.help: Scan the N most common ports (e.g., '1000').

inputs.label: Port Ratio (--port-ratio):
inputs.help: Scan ports with a ratio greater than the given value (0.0-1.0).

inputs.label: Service/Version Detection (-sV)
inputs.help: Probe open ports to determine service/version info.

inputs.label: Timing Template (-T):
inputs.help: Set a timing template (0-5 or paranoid, sneaky, polite, normal, aggressive, insane).

inputs.label: Min Hostgroup (--min-hostgroup):
inputs.help: Minimum number of hosts to scan in parallel.

inputs.label: Max Hostgroup (--max-hostgroup):
inputs.help: Maximum number of hosts to scan in parallel.

inputs.label: Min Parallelism (--min-parallelism):
inputs.help: Minimum number of probes to send in parallel.

inputs.label: Max Parallelism (--max-parallelism):
inputs.help: Maximum number of probes to send in parallel.

inputs.label: Min RTT Timeout (--min-rtt-timeout):
inputs.help: Minimum round trip time timeout (ms).

inputs.label: Max RTT Timeout (--max-rtt-timeout):
inputs.help: Maximum round trip time timeout (ms).

inputs.label: Initial RTT Timeout (--initial-rtt-timeout):
inputs.help: Initial round trip time timeout (ms).

inputs.label: Max Retries (--max-retries):
inputs.help: Caps the number of port scan probe retransmissions.

inputs.label: Host Timeout (--host-timeout):
inputs.help: Give up on target host after this long (e.g., '30m', '2h').

inputs.label: Scan Delay (--scan-delay):
inputs.help: Delay between probes (e.g., '10ms', '1s').

inputs.label: Min Rate (--min-rate):
inputs.help: Send packets no slower than <number> per second.

inputs.label: Max Rate (--max-rate):
inputs.help: Send packets no faster than <number> per second.

inputs.label: OS Detection (-O)
inputs.help: Enable OS detection.

inputs.label: Service Version Detection (-sV)
inputs.help: Probe open ports to determine service/version info.

inputs.label: Aggressive Detection (-A)
inputs.help: Enable OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute.

inputs.label: Version Intensity (--version-intensity):
inputs.help: Set version scan intensity (0-9). 9 is default.

inputs.label: Version Light (--version-light)
inputs.help: Light mode for version scan (intensity 2).

inputs.label: Version All (--version-all)
inputs.help: Try every single probe for version detection.

inputs.label: Aggressive OS Guessing (--osscan-guess)
inputs.help: Guess OS more aggressively.

inputs.label: Limit OS Guesses (--osscan-limit)
inputs.help: Limit OS detection to promising targets.

inputs.label: Service Info on All Ports (--all-ports)
inputs.help: Don't exclude any ports from the default service scan.

inputs.label: Fragment Packets (-f)
inputs.help: Fragment IP packets into tiny pieces (8 bytes or less).

inputs.label: MTU (--mtu):
inputs.help: Specify your own offset size (e.g., '24', '48').

inputs.label: Decoy Scan (-D):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of decoy IP addresses (e.g., 'RND:5,ME,192.168.1.1').

inputs.label: Idle Scan (-sI):
inputs.help: Idle scan (zombie host). e.g., 'zombie.example.com'.

inputs.label: Spoof MAC Address (--spoof-mac):
inputs.help: MAC address to spoof (e.g., '00:0C:29:12:34:56' or 'Dell').

inputs.label: Source Port (--source-port):
inputs.help: Specify source port number (e.g., '53', '80').

inputs.label: Data Length (--data-length):
inputs.help: Append random data to sent packets (e.g., '25').

inputs.label: Bad Checksum (--badsum)
inputs.help: Send packets with a bogus TCP/UDP/SCTP checksum.

inputs.label: Randomize Hosts (--randomize-hosts)
inputs.help: Randomize target host order.

inputs.label: Randomize Ports (--randomize-ports)
inputs.help: Randomize scanned port order.

inputs.label: IP Options (--ip-options):
inputs.help: Send packets with specified IP options (e.g., 'R').

inputs.label: TTL (--ttl):
inputs.help: Set IPv4 time-to-live field.

inputs.label: Max Retries (--max-retries):
inputs.help: Caps the number of port scan probe retransmissions.

inputs.label: Host Timeout (--host-timeout):
inputs.help: Give up on target host after this long.

inputs.label: Scan Delay (--scan-delay):
inputs.help: Delay between probes.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other Nmap arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line (e.g., '--exclude 192.168.1.5').

inputs.label: Normal Output (-oN):
inputs.help: Output to normal text file.

inputs.label: XML Output (-oX):
inputs.help: Output to XML file.

inputs.label: Grepable Output (-oG):
inputs.help: Output to grepable file.

inputs.label: All Formats (-oA):
inputs.help: Output in all major formats (normal, XML, grepable).

inputs.label: Verbose (-v)
inputs.help: Increase verbosity level (use -vv for more).

inputs.label: Debug (-d)
inputs.help: Increase debugging level (use -dd for more).

inputs.label: Reason (--reason)
inputs.help: Show the reason a host or port is in a particular state.

inputs.label: Open Ports Only (--open)
inputs.help: Only show open (or possibly open) ports.

inputs.label: Packet Trace (--packet-trace)
inputs.help: Show all packets sent and received.

inputs.label: Resume Scan (--resume):
inputs.help: Resume an aborted scan.

inputs.label: Append Output (--append-output)
inputs.help: Append to specified output files rather than clobbering them.

inputs.label: No Host Discovery (--no-host-discovery)
inputs.help: Do not perform host discovery.

inputs.label: Show Version (--version)
inputs.help: Show Nmap version number and exit.

inputs.label: Show Help (-h)
inputs.help: Display help message and exit.

inputs.label: Script Scan (-sC)
inputs.help: Perform a default script scan.

inputs.label: Scripts (--script):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of scripts, script categories, or directory (e.g., 'default,vuln', 'http-enum', '/path/to/scripts').

inputs.label: Script Arguments (--script-args):
inputs.help: Arguments for NSE scripts (e.g., 'http.useragent=Mozilla,http.max-pipeline=10'). One argument per line.

inputs.label: Script Timeout (--script-timeout):
inputs.help: Set maximum execution time for scripts (e.g., '5m').

inputs.label: Script Trace (--script-trace)
inputs.help: Show all data sent and received by scripts.

inputs.label: Script Debug (--script-debug)
inputs.help: Increase debug level for scripts.

inputs.label: Script Help (--script-help):
inputs.help: Show help for specified scripts (e.g., 'http-enum').

inputs.label: Update Script DB (--script-updatedb)
inputs.help: Update the script database.

inputs.label: Show Failed Scripts (--script-fags)
inputs.help: Show scripts that failed to run.

inputs.label: Interface (-e):
inputs.help: Use specified network interface.

inputs.label: Source Address (-S):
inputs.help: Spoof source IP address.

inputs.label: Payload Length (--data-length):
inputs.help: Append random data to sent packets (e.g., '25').

inputs.label: Max Parallelism (--max-parallelism):
inputs.help: Maximum number of probes to send in parallel.

inputs.label: Min Parallelism (--min-parallelism):
inputs.help: Minimum number of probes to send in parallel.

inputs.help: Show all packets sent and received.
